title: Project Jupiter Statement on Southern New Mexico Floods
summary: Our thoughts are with everyone affected by the recent floods in Southern New Mexico, and our focus is on the community and how we can help our neighbors in need during this emergency.
body_markdown:
Austin, Texas—Sep 30, 2026


“Our thoughts are with everyone affected by the recent floods in Southern New Mexico. Our focus is on the community and how we can help our neighbors in need during this emergency. We've seen the impact of the floods on homes, businesses, farms and roadways and know that recovery requires time, effort and resources. We are listening to local leaders and exploring the best ways to help our neighbors as they recover. Flooding also reached the Project Jupiter campus. No critical infrastructure was damaged, and we are working with our partners and insurers to address any impacts at the site. Project Jupiter remains on our planned schedule.” – Michael Egbert, Vice President, Oracle and Nikki Wheeler, Vice President, Public Relations & Communications, STACK Americas
